connectionIndex.title: Streamer.bot connection number
connectionIndex.description: Use 0 for the first OBS or Streamlabs connection. Meld also accepts 0 for its first saved connection.

breakIntervalMinutes.title: Manual break interval (minutes)
breakIntervalMinutes.description: Used only for a manual schedule. Automatic scheduling uses half of streams under two hours, capped at one break per hour for longer streams.

breakSceneName.title: Break scene
breakSceneName.description: Choose the exact scene to show when the break begins. role:break uses the Break scene you chose under Add-ons > Scene roles.

returnSceneName.title: Return scene
returnSceneName.description: Used only when After the break is set to a selected scene.

endingSceneName.title: Ending scene
endingSceneName.description: Used for automatic ending. Opening this scene manually also hands off to your configured ending sequence. role:ending uses the Ending scene you chose under Add-ons > Scene roles.

showOverlayWarning.title: Show countdown reminders on the extension overlay

breakPlatforms.title: Channels that allow automatic breaks
breakPlatforms.description: Select the platforms that can activate the break schedule. No selections disables automatic breaks. Scene changes apply to the shared broadcast layout.

breakEnabledScenes.title: Scenes that allow breaks and reminders
breakEnabledScenes.description: Choose exact scene names. An empty list allows every scene. Outside these scenes, reminders are hidden and due breaks are skipped; an active break still returns after its saved duration.

endWarningSceneName.title: Five-minute warning scene
endWarningSceneName.description: Switch here when the end warning begins. Leave empty to keep the current scene.

endingSceneMode.title: At the end of the countdown

chatAnnouncementsEnabled.title: Announce breaks and the stream end in chat
chatAnnouncementsEnabled.description: Posts once in every live chat when a break warning or the end warning starts.

breakChatMessage.title: Break announcement
breakChatMessage.description: Placeholders: {breakMinutes} (break length) and {warningMinutes} (time until the break).
breakChatMessage.default: Heads up! A mandatory {breakMinutes}-minute wellness break starts in {warningMinutes} minutes. We will be right back!

endChatMessage.title: Stream end announcement
endChatMessage.description: Sent only when Limit total stream length is on. Placeholder: {warningMinutes}.
endChatMessage.default: Heads up! The stream wraps up in {warningMinutes} minutes. Thank you for hanging out!

soundCuesEnabled.title: Play a sound when a countdown starts and near the end
soundCuesEnabled.description: Plays on the extension overlay, so that browser source must be in the scene.

finalCountdownSeconds.title: Second sound plays this many seconds before
